variants.suspected_cause: Positive A4 displacements map to data-hunk symbols two bytes below the displacement because the linked A4 bias is 0x7ffe.
variants.controlled_change: Rename each touched positive-offset global to its data-hunk identity using displacement plus the measured A4 bias; leave code expressions unchanged.

predicted_effect.note: Only external symbol identities should change; function length and instruction structure should remain fixed.
